# Akshay & Kirti — Wedding Website

This is the official wedding website for **Akshay Kumar** and **Kirti Katta**, who are getting married in
Jaipur, Rajasthan, India on **20 November 2026** (celebrations run 18–20 November 2026).

The site is a single-page invitation that covers: the couple, their love story, the three days of
wedding events, a gallery, guest accommodation info, and an RSVP form.

## Key facts

- Couple: Akshay Kumar & Kirti Katta
- Wedding date: 20 November 2026, 7:00 PM — Phool Mahal, Jaipur
- Celebration days:
  - Day 1 · 18 Nov 2026 — Mehendi & Cocktail party
  - Day 2 · 19 Nov 2026 — Haldi, Tilak & Engagement (Musical/Sangeet night)
  - Day 3 · 20 Nov 2026 — Wedding: Baraat, Jaimala/Varmala, Rituals, Pheras
- Guest accommodation: Golden Eagle, Jaipur (blocked room block)
- RSVP: available on the website (no personal guest data is published)

## Note

Replace `akshayandkirti.wedding` with the live domain before deploying. No private or guest information
is exposed on this site. The wedding/venue address and contact details are shared privately with invited
guests.
